suites.name: source-performance
suites.rationale: Synthetic cold launch, restored Studio picker, paged profile search and deep-scroll rendering with 3,000 source assets.

suites.rationale: Local cell creation and numeric sizing preserve text placement across keyboard previews, cancellation, failed saves, Undo/Redo and reload at wide and narrow desktop sizes.

suites.name: composition-single-line
suites.rationale: An explicit single-line cell keeps its height, fades horizontally without a reading action, and persists through Composition Undo/Redo and reload.

suites.name: interface-theme
suites.rationale: One persistent Dark/Light preference across Settings, portal menus, Composition, canvas overview, and login without editing compositions.

suites.name: composition-index
suites.rationale: Desktop index camera gestures, per-composition navigation, read-only viewing, owner activation and persistence failures with actual artwork.

suites.name: publication-local
suites.rationale: Thirty canvases with overlapping Library/reference records prepare and upload from the local origin through the hosted publication service without an on-chain write.

suites.name: svg-pan-retention
suites.rationale: Twelve animated SVG documents survive repeated offscreen camera pans, pause/resume, preserve identity and avoid reload labels in Owner and Visitor at wide/narrow viewports.

suites.name: composition-styling
suites.rationale: Filled Composition typography across reader/editor, header editing, shared Colour and nested touch controls in Composition and Workbench. Also runs against dist with INSCAPE_STYLING_PRODUCTION=1.

suites.name: svg-artwork-lift
suites.rationale: Opening and inspecting SVG artwork preserves its document and geometry.

suites.name: svg-raster-quality
suites.rationale: Gerichte artwork/Image-regressie voor aanvullende geometrie, pixel- of lifecyclevarianten; expliciet draaien wanneer die grens wijzigt. Concreet: embedded WebP thumbnails stay filtered while Inspect prepares original pixels for Lift.

suites.name: text-create
suites.rationale: Add Text uses the context-menu invocation point through pan, zoom, undo and reload.

suites.name: text-empty-editor
suites.rationale: empty writing area is discoverable without authoring placeholder content.

suites.name: text-frame-columns
suites.rationale: frame height fills columns sequentially, preserves text and reports excess content through resize and reload.

suites.name: text-inspector
suites.rationale: Text Inspector preserves editing, formatting, search and document appearance.
prerequisites: Neem benodigde lokaal ongetrackte fixtures/assets bewust op bij latere bronintegratie; huidige HEAD/CI bevat ze niet: browser-tests/fixtures/shared-tools.mjs

suites.name: text-interaction
suites.rationale: Text body moves in Read, preserves selection in Write and cancels movement without saving previews.

suites.name: text-library-insertion
suites.rationale: Library artwork is inserted at the drop point in Write. Read reports rejected drops in the Library.

suites.name: text-line-spacing
suites.rationale: line spacing and long illustrated text remain editable and reachable.

suites.name: text-module
suites.rationale: Text module authors, reloads, renders and contains content at wide/narrow widths.

suites.name: text-panel
suites.rationale: independent Text panel matches Layers and resizes without authoring (${theme}, ${width}px).

suites.name: text-parity
suites.rationale: illustrated Text has matching title, glyph positions and line breaks in Write and Read.
prerequisites: Neem benodigde lokaal ongetrackte fixtures/assets bewust op bij latere bronintegratie; huidige HEAD/CI bevat ze niet: browser-tests/fixtures/shared-tools.mjs

suites.name: text-scroll-fit
suites.rationale: Text scrolls only when content exceeds its viewport in Write and Read.

suites.name: text-search
suites.rationale: article search and replacement preserve content and undo.

suites.name: text-toolbar-hover
suites.rationale: Text toolbar stays reachable across its gap / DPR ${density}${below ? ' below' : ''}.

suites.name: text-tools-resize
suites.rationale: content-sized fixed-width windows recover their width after a narrow viewport.
prerequisites: Neem benodigde lokaal ongetrackte fixtures/assets bewust op bij latere bronintegratie; huidige HEAD/CI bevat ze niet: browser-tests/fixtures/shared-tools.mjs

suites.name: text-transfer
suites.rationale: Text controls respect composition clipping across viewport sizes and zoom levels.
prerequisites: Neem benodigde lokaal ongetrackte fixtures/assets bewust op bij latere bronintegratie; huidige HEAD/CI bevat ze niet: browser-tests/fixtures/shared-tools.mjs

suites.name: text-typography
suites.rationale: clicking a small sub-label preserves the target and joined lines can be separated before spacing.
prerequisites: Neem benodigde lokaal ongetrackte fixtures/assets bewust op bij latere bronintegratie; huidige HEAD/CI bevat ze niet: browser-tests/fixtures/shared-tools.mjs

suites.name: text-writing
suites.rationale: writing, clipboard and artwork editing.

suites.name: visitor-dock-layering
suites.rationale: Gerichte bestaande module-/workflowcontrole; geen functioneel vervangingsbewijs gevonden en daarom behouden. Concreet: Visitor and Preview dock stays visible and clickable above overlapping Text.

suites.name: visitor-mint
suites.rationale: Gerichte bestaande module-/workflowcontrole; geen functioneel vervangingsbewijs gevonden en daarom behouden. Concreet: visitor can cancel by keyboard, recover focus and confirm a simulated mint.

suites.name: workbench-artwork-layers
suites.rationale: Release: de echte Workbench-volgorde, compositieblokken, tijdelijke ogen, verwijderen/Undo en Visitor-projectie zijn nieuwe auteursgrenzen buiten de huidige defaults.

suites.name: workbench-camera
suites.rationale: Gerichte Workbench-regressie naast de brede releaseflows; aanvullende camera-, window-, selectie- of herstelvarianten niet verwijderen. Concreet: cursor camera and grid stay aligned after pan, reverse smoothly, and ignore selection scope.
prerequisites: ASSERTION_REVIEW browser-tests/workbench-camera.browser.mjs:21: Verwacht een detached window onder data-context-tools; toetsen tegen de actuele shared-dock-host, zonder camera-/toolgeometriegaranties te verliezen.

suites.name: workbench-context-menu
suites.rationale: Workbench menu checks keyboard interaction, submenu traversal, and sidebar reopening.

suites.name: workbench-destinations
suites.rationale: Release: expliciete camera-bestemmingen, onderbroken Back, late doelwijziging en zoomindicatie vullen de nieuwe Navigator- en bestemmingspanelencontroles aan.

suites.name: workbench-docs
suites.rationale: Gerichte Workbench-regressie naast de brede releaseflows; aanvullende camera-, window-, selectie- of herstelvarianten niet verwijderen. Concreet: Docs tabs explain the current modules and remain usable at wide and narrow widths.

suites.rationale: Prestatie met gedragsdekking: meet React-commits tijdens gevuld Workbench-pan/coast en controleert geometry/reduced-motion/scroll; gericht draaien bij camera- of renderingwijzigingen.
prerequisites: Meet browser, hardware/renderer, viewport, inhoud, CPU/trace/record/measure-only-variabelen en duur; geen releasegroen afleiden uit observationele modus.

suites.rationale: Gerichte Workbench-regressie naast de brede releaseflows; aanvullende camera-, window-, selectie- of herstelvarianten niet verwijderen. Concreet: published Workbench restores new Identity content, module layout and session-only interaction.

suites.name: workbench-preferences
suites.rationale: Workbench-voorkeuren behouden de laatste instellingen bij opslagfalen, tonen onafhankelijke herstelacties en vervangen onleesbare records alleen expliciet.

suites.name: scene-boundaries
suites.rationale: Composition, public artwork and Gallery preserve navigation and scroll.

suites.name: composition-gutter-pixels
suites.rationale: Bento gutter coverage at fractional zoom and pixel phases; positive gaps remain visible without inventing spacing, and zero gutters remain seamless.

suites.name: composition-bento-placement
suites.rationale: Bento equal-edge snapping and cancellation, left/upper insertion and full-width strip relocation with Undo and reload at desktop sizes.

suites.name: composition-frame-opacity
suites.rationale: Frame line opacity uses shared controls and survives undo, reload and Preview without changing geometry.

suites.name: composition-inspect
suites.rationale: Introductory text excerpts, fixed ellipsis, compact scrollbar-free reading, keyboard return and unchanged saved content.

suites.name: composition-text-resize
suites.rationale: Bento text keeps resize axes independent and clips complete lines in native Editor at different zooms, including live preview, Undo and reload.

suites.name: composition-native-editor
suites.rationale: Composition in the existing Editor: native rectangles, cell membership, Library and Text, movement, history, isolated persistence and responsive preview.

suites.name: composition-image-inspect
suites.rationale: Passive introductory artwork preserves crops and live media; stacked text reading and document replacement preserve the draft.

suites.name: composition-svg-breakpoints
suites.rationale: Live SVG documents survive repeated narrow/wide Composition reflow and artwork clicks without disappearing, restarting animation or changing the draft.

suites.name: composition-cell-interaction
suites.rationale: Native Composition cell entry from actual double-clicks, image-covered cells, scoped Bento settings, shared split/merge actions and selected-cell styling.

suites.name: composition-layer-order
suites.rationale: Native Composition, preview and public rendering preserve interleaved global artwork order, rounded cell clipping, Text appearance and linked source actions.

suites.name: editor-menu-bar
suites.rationale: Fixed Editor menus, keyboard and focus, full sidebar visibility, canvas save failures and history, tool preferences and destinations at desktop and phone widths.

suites.name: workbench-side-dock
suites.rationale: Screen-edge reach, persistent right docking, shared width and stack resizing, undocking and cancellation with Navigator and Keeper, without artwork changes.

suites.name: owner-workspace
suites.rationale: Shared owner frame, contextual menus, bidirectional canvas presentation, retained camera and save guards, reduced motion and narrow viewport behavior.

suites.name: composition-tiling
suites.rationale: Native Bento centre swap, local/outer insertion, exact preview, cancellation and atomic save/Undo/reload.

suites.name: library-divider
suites.rationale: Library navigation and hidden scrolling retain stable width across panel resizing.

suites.name: library-organization
suites.rationale: Library folder and section authoring persist atomically and retain naming focus.

suites.name: library-panels
suites.rationale: One retained Library instance through toolbar opening, detaching, joining Inspector, sidebar reveal, closure and layout reload in wide/narrow editor views.
